title: Extraterrestrial being interviewed behind a two-way mirror at S4

tellings.quote: so they went to Area 51 they got taken to S4 uh went down a number of flights down at S4 and they came to this area where there was this a a big room with a two-way mirror in it and there was an extraterrestrial being there

plain: Sometime in the 1950s or 60s, a group was taken to Area 51, the secret Nevada test base, and on to S4, a site said to lie nearby, where they went down several floors to a large room with a two-way mirror and a living extraterrestrial being behind it. A guest named Dan Sheehan tells Michels this second-hand, as what a man named Albert Stein told him, and links it to what he calls the S4 interview card files; if true, it would mean the US government held and questioned a living alien.
